newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver recovers by close, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver recovers by close, gold steady.

text.p: Silver prices opened lower on Friday on a weak world trend but recovered its early losses by close on fresh industrial buying, dealers said.
"Restricted arrivals of imported silver also helped," said a dealer. Silver was quiet on Thursday but was up 50 rupees on the previous day.
"The cost of imported silver was higher around 6,900 rupees per kg resulting in reduced arrivals," the dealer said.
Gold opened subdued and remained steady in dull trade, dealers said. Gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) held steady at 58,700 rupees per piece. They were down 100 rupees on Thursday.
